This fixture proves LIVE that the family is not merely a one-edge assertion that cannot distinguish 'processed every route-bound function' from 'processed only the first one': HandleWidgets (GET+POST /widgets, deduped to one row by runs_in's own functionID+repoID dedupe key, which has no method dimension) and HandleHealth (GET /healthz, a distinct handler on a distinct path) both bind, yielding TWO edges.
